description: Pull public TikTok data with the harshmaur/tiktok-scraper Apify Actor: a creator's videos, hashtag feeds, keyword search (videos or accounts), single video links, sounds, comments with replies, followers and following lists, plus optional watermark-free MP4 downloads, transcripts and AI labels (category, sponsored, brand safety, sentiment, custom yes/no questions). Free date and likes filters and exact hashtag match. Use when the user says "scrape this TikTok account", "top TikTok videos for #<tag> this week", "TikTok videos about X with over 100k likes", "export comments from this TikTok", "who follows @<user>", "vet these TikTok creators for brand safety", "transcribe these TikToks", "track our campaign hashtag", or asks for TikTok data as JSON or CSV. No TikTok account, cookies or API key is needed. The input copies clockworks/tiktok-scraper field names. Out of scope: posting, liking or messaging, private accounts, stories, TikTok Shop products and TikTok ads.
